# narrative time axis

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:narrativeTimeAxis`](gmeow-narrativeTimeAxis.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/narrativeTimeAxis>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

The axis kind of this narrative time frame — discourse time or story time. Functional: a frame measures exactly one axis; a work and its fabula are two frames, not one frame with two moods.
